name: Embedded Systems Laboratory
description: The lab introduces students to the usage of embedded systems, their firmware, and the fundamental development tools and toolchains. It covers interfacing commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) embedded platforms with real-world sensors and actuators using various communication protocols and provides hands-on experience with firmware components such as monitors, operating systems, and device drivers.
